part.text:
The images are ready. Here's a summary:

**Views found:** 1 — `SystemContext` (the only view defined in `workspace.dsl`)

**Files written to `/work`:**
- **`SystemContext.svg`** — the rendered view: Patron (person) → Library (system) over HTTPS, with the C4 legend, using standard C4-PlantUML styling (teal person `#0E7C7B`, blue system `#1168BD`, left-to-right layout)
- `SystemContext.puml` — the exported C4-PlantUML source, kept alongside for reference

**One caveat to be transparent about:** this sandbox has no diagram renderer (no Java/Node/Python, no `plantuml`/`mmdc`, no package manager) and no external network access (the PlantUML server is unreachable), so I couldn't run a real PlantUML render. Instead I generated the SVG directly from the exported view data (elements, relationship, title, legend). It's a faithful C4-style rendering, but if you want pixel-identical PlantUML output, you can run `plantuml SystemContext.puml` anywhere with PlantUML installed — the `.puml` file is ready for that.
